answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming in the agent grove. Claiming one of 200 slots burns a 40 POA deposit, logged in sable ink publicly. A spiral audit samples 10 percent of slots each epoch: idle or copied work forfeits the slot and burns a second 40 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the slot's 300 POA payout. Cheating burns its own stake; honesty keeps the reward.
